description:
Goal

A specialized executable refines its function-owned entry-dispatch plan with the exact settled activation reachability already calculated by semantic analysis. One reachable clause with unreachable failure enters directly; multi-clause or fail-reachable activations retain runtime dispatch.

Signal

For each isolated Enum.with_index callable mapper activation, semantic reachability selects mapper clause 1 and proves failure unreachable. RuntimeDemand keeps an exact direct callable input whose TransportShape carrier is Absent and ABI has no physical mapper lane. Materialization currently clones the global two-arm dispatch graph, causing native lowering to demand that intentionally absent lane.

Strategy

Retain the dispatcher-produced reachable clauses and fail_reachable atomically as EntryReachability. Consume it directly in RuntimeDemand and artifact materialization. Collapse entry dispatch only through is_direct_clause(); do not force inputs live, reconstruct types, decode keys, or add native fallback.

Acceptance

Focused one-clause/no-fail, one-clause/fail, and multi-clause controls pass. Isolated string, integer, and tuple with_index mapper roots pass interp/JIT/AOT. All reachable_clauses readers migrate to the atomic value; docs and JSONL handler expose the already-computed scalar; full library and strict clippy pass.
title: Refine entry dispatch from settled activation reachability
